en.title: io in iod (iodine)
en.summary: The diphthong io is found in the Romanian word iod.

sections.title: The sound io
paragraphs: The letters io sound like the sequence /jo/. Their main sound is heard in the word (iod) /jod/, which means iodine. These letters have two different pronunciations in Romanian speech.

sections.title: Mouth shape
paragraphs: First glide quickly from a tight tongue position to a circle. Raise your tongue high near the roof of your mouth, then move into an o shape while making sound. For the other variant, make two separate sounds. Say a clear ee, then shape your lips into a small circle for o. Touch your throat to feel your voice buzz throughout both sounds.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters io usually merge into the quick sound /jo/, as in (ghiozdan) /ɡjozˈdan/. In foreign loans and words with prefixes, the two vowels split across two syllables, making the sound /i.o/. You hear this separate rhythm in (biologie) /bi.o.loˈd͡ʒi.e/ and (avion) /a.viˈon/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace the first sound with a long vowel from words like see. Keep the glide fast and smooth, like the y in yoke. Do not blend the letters when they belong to separate beats. Say both parts distinctly.
